title.description: Title or heading for the notification. Shown in the title slot if showTitle is true. Available when showTitle==true && type!=Inactive && empty==false.

description.description: Detailed message text for the notification. Shown in the description slot if showDescription is true. Available when showDescription==true && type!=Inactive && empty==false.

time.description: Primary timestamp to display (e.g., "09:12:46"). Shown in the time slot if showTimestamp is true. Available when showTimestamp==true && type!=Inactive && empty==false.

timeSecondary.description: The second time, drawn while `hasTimestamp2` is true.

actionLabel.description: The text of the action button, drawn by the `with-button` type.

type.description: Display type of the notification. - simple: Basic notification (default). - with-button: Includes a text action button. - with-icon-button: Includes an icon action. - inactive: Shows empty/inactive state.

size.description: Size variant of the notification. - regular: Standard compact layout (default). - tall: Expanded layout for longer content.

hasTimestamp2.description: Whether to show the secondary timestamp. If false, the time-secondary slot is omitted. Available when type!=Inactive && empty==false.

hasSecondaryIcon.description: Whether to show the secondary icon overlay. If true, renders the secondary-icon slot. Available when type!=Inactive && empty==false.

large.description: **DEPRECATED** – Use size="tall" instead. If true, uses the tall layout.

empty.description: **DEPRECATED** – Use type="inactive" instead. If true, shows the empty/inactive state.

emptyText.description: The text drawn while `empty` is true (or the type is `inactive`).

showTitle.description: Whether the item draws its title.

showDescription.description: Whether the item draws its description.

showTimestamp.description: Whether the item draws its time.

secondaryIconName.description: The icon in the `secondary-icon` slot, by name (an OpenBridge icon the module bundles); empty puts none. Additional icon for status/priority (shown when hasSecondaryIcon is true).

componentSize.description: OpenBridge component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
